anchors.paper_title: iEEG-BIDS, extending the Brain Imaging Data Structure specification to human intracranial electrophysiology
anchors.reason: iEEG-BIDS is a specification for organizing iEEG data in BIDS, used to format this sEEG dataset; it does not describe the CerebroVoice data.

metadata.methods_description: sEEG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a Nihon Kohden EEG-1200 system using platinum-iridium depth electrodes. Recordings lasted about 73 minutes for SUB1 (114 channels after filtering) and about 76 minutes for SUB2 (158 channels). Data were preprocessed into NPY derivatives (LFS, HGA, BBS) and converted to BIDS-iEEG format.
